## Notice
This template is for non-critical security hardening suggestions, documentation improvements, or general security queries only.

If this is an exploitable vulnerability, an unauthenticated bypass, memory corruption, or unsafe raw disk operation bug, please follow the **private vulnerability reporting** instructions outlined above and in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
